programme.title: South Park VOSE: Amanecer gris
programme.desc: Los conductores de la tercera edad se ven obligados a entregar sus carnés de conducir después de provocar el caos. El abuelo de Stan llama a la AARP para que les ayude.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Casa Bonita
programme.desc: Kyle invita a Butters en vez de a Cartman a su fiesta de cumpleaños, así que Cartman convence a Butters de que un meteorito va a colisionar con la tierra y lo mete en un refugio antibombas para poder ir en su lugar.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Todo sobre los mormones
programme.desc: Un nuevo niño, Gary, llega a South Park y su familia es mormona. Eric se hace su amigo, pero se desilusiona con la historia mormona.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: No fumes
programme.desc: Los chicos se quedan atrapados fumando y el colegio se incendia. Un grupo radican antitabaco llega al pueblo y quiere matar a Cartman para demostrar que el tabaquismo pasivo mata.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Pasas
programme.desc: Wendy deja a Stan y este se convierte en gótico para regodearse en su dolor.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Es Navidad en Canadá
programme.desc: Los padres biológicos de Ike, el hermano adoptivo de Kyle, consiguen llevárselo a Canadá porque el presidente canadiense ha decretado que todos los niños adoptados de Canadá tienen que ser devueltos.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Buenos tiempos con armas
programme.desc: Después de comprar armas de artes marciales en un mercadillo, los chicos se transforman en guerreros japoneses de anime con desastrosas consecuencias para el pobre Butters.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Genial-O, mi amigo robot
programme.desc: Cartman se disfraza de robot, se llama a sí mismo GENIAL-O y se muda con Butters. Su plan es descubrir los mayores secretos de Butters y entonces usarlos contra él.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Abajo con los esteroides
programme.desc: Son los Juegos paralímpicos de South Park y Cartman tiene que convencer al comité de que tiene una discapacidad para poder derrotar a Jimmy en el evento

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Espaldas babosas
programme.desc: South Park está abarrotado de trabajadores del futuro que aceptan todos los trabajos por menos dinero. Los hombres de South Park toman medidas curiosas para detenerlos.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Los Jefferson
programme.desc: Una nueva familia llega a South Park con un niño que se llama Blanket, un parque de atracciones en el jardín y un padre al que le gusta cantar y la cirugía estética. ¿Adivinas quién es?

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Ducha y zurullo
programme.desc: Cuando la PETA acaba con la mascota de South Park, las ideas para sustituirla dividen al colegio. Sean Combs amenaza a Stan y es expulsado del pueblo por negarse a votar.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Algo de Wall-Mart se aproxima
programme.desc: Wall-Mart convierte South Park en un pueblo fantasma, así que Stan y Kyle intentan destruirlo, pero un Cartman poseído se interpone en su camino.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Preescolar
programme.desc: Los chicos están en un buen lío cuando un chaval al que acusaron de prenderle fuego a un profesor sale del centro de menores.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: A la caza de audiencias
programme.desc: Los chicos se ven envueltos en una guerra de audiencias cuando su programa 'Supernoticias escolares' corre el riesgo de que lo cancelen, por lo que harán lo que sea por atraer espectadores.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Crea vídeos con puta, estúpida y malcriada
programme.desc: Paris Hilton abre una tienda en South Park y pervierte a todas las chicas del pueblo salvo a Wendy, que es la única que mantiene sus valores.
programme.sub-title: Crea vídeos con puta, estúpida y malcriada

programme.title: South Park VOSE: El increíble don de Cartman
programme.desc: Un desafortunado intento de volar acaba con Cartman en el hospital. La policía cree que tiene poderes psíquicos para resolver crímenes y lo alista para ayudarles a atrapar a un asesino en serie.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Muere, hippie, muere
programme.desc: Arrestan a Cartman por encarcelar hippies, pero cuando llega una plaga de hippies a South Park, el pueblo recurre a él y a sus métodos poco ortodoxos de eliminación de hippies.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Wing
programme.desc: Cartman, Stan y Kenny se llevan un 10 % de las ganancias de su cliente como cazatalentos. Pero después de esforzarse por impresionar a su único cliente, otra agencia se lo roba.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: La aburrida liga de béisbol
programme.desc: Los chicos están aburridos de jugar al béisbol y traman un plan para perder el gran partido del playoff. Randy entrena duro para convertirse en el borracho más idiota de cada partido.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: El día de la erección
programme.desc: A Jimmy le preocupa que sus erecciones constantes le impidan participar en el concurso de talentos y ganar el premio de 1000 dólares.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Marjorine
programme.desc: Cartman está convencido de que las chicas tienen un dispositivo para ver el futuro, así que Butters se disfraza de chica para infiltrarse entre ellas.

programme.title: 10.000 días
programme.desc: Hace 10.000 días, un cometa impactó con la Tierra en pleno océano Pacífico con la fuerza de incontables bombas nucleares, sumiendo al planeta en nieve y hielo.

programme.title: Amor de ida y vuelta
programme.desc: Dos actores de fenómenos televisivos (Juego de Tronos y Sex Education) protagonizan este fantástico romance. Un joven (Asa Butterfield) inventa una máquina del tiempo para recuperar a su exnovia (Sophie Turner).

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: Infinitum
programme.desc: Jane debe cambiar su realidad en un universo paralelo por su cuenta.

programme.title: Oceans Rising
programme.desc: Un científico construye un arca enorme después de que se ignoran sus advertencias de una inundación que destruirá la Tierra.

programme.title: San Andreas mega seísmo
programme.desc: Los científicos descubren algo horrible: el "Gran Terremoto" será en dos días y hundirá California en el océano. Su única esperanza es romper un volcán que desplazará la energía del terremoto y construirá una nueva corteza en la superficie.

programme.title: La señal, el balneario
programme.desc: En un viaje por carretera, Nic y dos amigos son atraídos a una zona aislada por un genio de la informática. Cuando de repente todo se vuelve oscuro, Nic recupera la consciencia, solo para encontrarse en una pesadilla al despertar.

programme.title: 10.000 días
programme.desc: Hace 10.000 días, un cometa impactó con la Tierra en pleno océano Pacífico con la fuerza de incontables bombas nucleares, sumiendo al planeta en nieve y hielo.

programme.title: En la tierra de sangre y miel
programme.desc: Historia de amor que tiene lugar durante la guerra de Bosnia de 1992-95 y se centra en una pareja que se conoce justo antes de que estalle la guerra y el efecto que esta tiene en su relación.

programme.title: La era del mañana
programme.desc: Cuando el sol golpea un altar, escondido dentro de la antigua Pirámide del Sol en México, se crea un faro que desencadena una guerra relámpago alienígena. En cuestión de horas, sus platillos destruyen toda la infraestructura militar de la tierra.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: El Escenario Oscuro
programme.desc: Un terrible engaño (CASO LAURENCE MAILLE): El 28 de noviembre de 2007, Laurence Maille desapareció.

programme.title: Casos Sin Resolver
programme.desc: El 5 de mayo de 1986, la pequeña Cécile Bloch, de 11 años, fue encontrada muerta en el sótano de su residencia en el distrito 19 de París.

programme.title: Infelices Para Siempre: Propuesta Sangrienta
programme.desc: Teresa gira extrovertida en su regio vestido. Se muere por casarse con Rob, su guapo prometido. Antes del picar de las campanas, un tiroteo de noche deja a ambos tendidos. La policía se enfrenta a un lío retorcido de ambición, engaño e infidelidad.

programme.title: Infelices Para Siempre: Triángulo Amoroso Descabellado
programme.desc: Diane se casa con su sexy novio, Bobby. Así empieza la historia de su nueva vida como mujer. Dos meses después, la novia transexual desaparece. Habrá que juntar todas las piezas de un terrible cuento de celos, amor y traición para resolver el caso.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Una familia de cuatro realiza el crucero de sus vidas, pero solo tres regresan a casa. Su desesperada búsqueda de su hija adulta desaparecida comienza, con todas las señales apuntando a un secuestro.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Una joven pareja gana un crucero con todos los gastos pagados con un boleto de rasca y gana. Pero su suerte se agota una vez a bordo, cuando uno de ellos termina asesinado.

programme.title: Contra Reloj
programme.desc: La misteriosa desaparición de Laëtitia Delecluse reveló una historia escalofriante de violencia doméstica y engaño.

programme.title: Contra Reloj
programme.desc: El ambiente sereno de Marcq-en-Barroeil se vio roto por la abrupta desaparición de Natacha Mougel durante su carrera de rutina.

programme.title: Las Primeras 72 Horas Tras El Crimen: Pesadilla
programme.desc: La peor pesadilla de toda mujer cobra vida cuando un depredador sexual barbudo comienza a atacar a las mujeres.

programme.title: Las Primeras 72 Horas Tras El Crimen: El Santo
programme.desc: Un chico de fraternidad atrae a una chica a su casa con la promesa de una fiesta, pero una vez allí resulta que tiene motivos ocultos.

programme.title: Las Primeras 72 Horas Tras El Crimen: Peligro en el Bosque
programme.desc: Tres adolescentes acompañan a un repartidor a una zona densamente boscosa para una fiesta de copas que, al poco tiempo, se convierte en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Muerte Misteriosa en la Casa Flotante
programme.desc: Dominique Aubry, una rica viuda de 58 años, aparece ahorcada en su barcaza en Neuilly.
programme.sub-title: Muerte Misteriosa en la Casa Flotante

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Un Suicidio Muy Extraño
programme.desc: La policía de Estrasburgo recibe una sorprendente llamada de emergencia del doctor Jean-Louis Muller, un patólogo forense muy conocido en la región.

programme.title: Wives with Knives
programme.desc: Crystal Johnson anhela el amor, pero padece paranoia y es propensa a la violencia, lo que desata su agresión. Cuando cree que su novio la engaña, lo apuñala con un cuchillo de cocina.

programme.title: Wives with Knives
programme.desc: Carol Singh emigra a Nueva York desde Surinam buscando el sueño americano. Pero, cuando su celoso novio Dave se muestra cada vez más violento, una pelea a cuchilladas en la cocina acaba con Dave muerto y Carol entre rejas.

programme.title: Wives with Knives
programme.desc: Tras una exitosa carrera como traficante de cocaína en el glamuroso Fort Lauderdale de los años 80, Donna Buchanan se junta con un señor mayor llamado Charlie. Pero Charlie resulta ser alguien que propicia el consumo y un maltratador.

programme.title: Wives with Knives
programme.desc: Diane se enamora del carismático político Joe Reilly, pero, en cuanto se dan el "sí, quiero", Joe muestra el tirano maltratador que lleva dentro. Una de las discusiones va a más y Joe acaba en el hospital por heridas de arma blanca.

programme.title: FBI Takedown
programme.desc: Las Fuerzas de Operaciones Especiales del FBI encaran uno de los retos más difíciles hasta ahora: atrapar a una banda de ladrones profesionales dispuestos a matar y retar al código de silencio hermético de uno de los vecindarios más rudos de Boston.

programme.title: Casos Sin Resolver
programme.desc: El 17 de marzo de 1983, Ludovic, de 6 años, fue secuestrado ante los ojos de su hermano mayor Jérôme en las afueras de Grenoble.

programme.title: Clarividentes
programme.desc: El asesinato de una pareja de ancianos conmociona a un pequeño pueblo de Nueva York. Una familia de Ohio busca a una mujer desaparecida. Dos psíquicos presenciaron todo lo sucedido.

programme.title: Linda Napolitano: La Abducción Alienígena del Siglo
programme.desc: La abducción alienígena de Linda Napolitano en 1989 es el caso de abducción del siglo.

programme.title: La Batalla OVNI de Los Ángeles
programme.desc: 1942 LA: Un misterioso OVNI causa apagón y fuego de artillería. Permanece sin explicación.

programme.title: Cazadores De Ovnis II: Cuentos del Universo
programme.desc: Los ufólogos italianos exploran la evidencia alienígena en la historia y el folclore. ¿Hemos sido observados desde la antigüedad?

programme.title: Encuentros Extraterrestres: Los Grises
programme.desc: ¿Quiénes son los alienígenas grises y cuál es su interés en nuestro mundo? En este documental exploramos los posibles motivos detrás de tres de los encuentros más prolíficos en nuestra historia.

programme.title: Ingenieros Extraterrestres
programme.desc: Nuestra evolución puede estar influenciada por nuestros antepasados y sus dioses. No estamos solos en el universo.

programme.title: Hopkinsville: Los Duendes Extraterrestres
programme.desc: Una familia lucha contra los alienígenas goblins en un misterioso encuentro, lo que provoca debates e investigaciones. El miedo impulsa sus acciones.

programme.title: Extraterrestres en la URSS
programme.desc: Misterios alienígenas sin resolver de la Unión Soviética: incidente del Paso Dyatlov, milagro de Petrozavodsk, caso Voronezh. Asombro y miedo, pero duda de la participación alienígena.

programme.title: Cazadores De Ovnis: Los Ufólogos Italianos
programme.desc: Investigadores italianos exploran avistamientos masivos de ovnis, clipeología y testimonios reales, profundizando en la historia y los métodos de investigación de la ufología.

programme.title: Cíclope Extraterrestre: El Extraordinario Caso de la Sagrada Familia
programme.desc: En 1963 en Brasil, tres niños son testigos de un OVNI en su patio trasero. Un cíclope alienígena desciende y el Sr. Alberto investiga el fenómeno.

programme.title: Extraterrestres contra la Guerra Nuclear: Edgar Mitchell
programme.desc: 12 caminantes lunares afirman que los extraterrestres visitaron la Tierra, el gobierno lo encubrió. Los extraterrestres detuvieron la guerra nuclear. ¿Loco o vale la pena escuchar más?

programme.title: Extraterrestres Ancestrales: El Origen de la Humanidad
programme.desc: La creciente evidencia y los avistamientos de ovnis sugieren contacto con seres extraterrestres que pueden haber influido en los orígenes de la vida humana.

programme.title: Señales de OVNIs en la Historia Humana
programme.desc: Gracias a la extensa investigación realizada por el erudito Ivan Ceci, hemos descubierto numerosos avistamientos de OVNIs que datan desde el 300 a.C. hasta la actualidad. Este notable hallazgo fue posible gracias a una minuciosa investigación.

programme.title: Extraterrestres Subterráneos, Baba Vanga y Biología Cuántica
programme.desc: Baba Vanga, una mística búlgara ciega, hizo predicciones desde los 12 años hasta su muerte en 1996. Sus profecías se extendieron hasta el año 5079.

programme.title: OVNI: Primer Contacto
programme.desc: Nos adentramos en avistamientos de OVNIs y encuentros cercanos que involucran aeronaves comerciales y militares, trayéndoles los relatos más asombrosos de pilotos que han presenciado objetos voladores no identificados durante sus vuelos.

programme.title: Rec 4: Apocalypse
programme.desc: Una reportera de televisión es rescatada y enviada a un viaje a través del océano, pero la persigue un virus mortal.

programme.title: Rec 3: Genesis
programme.desc: Koldo y Clara están hechos el uno para el otro. Van a celebrar su enlace acompañados de sus seres queridos. Pero una negra sombra se cierne sobre ellos. En el día más feliz de sus vidas, el infierno va a desatarse. Precuela de la saga de terror.

programme.title: Deadheads
programme.desc: Mike y Brent vuelven a la vida en medio de un brote de zombis. Después de que Mike descubra un anillo de compromiso en su bolsillo, emprenderá junto a Brent una aventura por carretera en busca del amor perdido.

programme.title: Asylum
programme.desc: Brandon se prepara para presentar su último monólogo. A medida que cuenta sus historias y chistes, el público se anima. Sin embargo, en ese instante el cómico se da cuenta que sus historias tienen mucho que ver con su pasado.

programme.title: El ministerio del miedo
programme.desc: Tras dos años de reclusión, Stephen Neale abandona el sanatorio mental de Lembridge. Se encuentra entonces con un mundo distinto que nada tiene que ver con lo que él conocía.

programme.title: El doble asesinato en la calle Morgue
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, un sádico doctor de París se dedica a secuestrar a mujeres jóvenes para realizar experimentos que puedan ayudarle a confirmar sus teorías sobre la evolución del mono al hombre.

programme.title: Barba azul
programme.desc: Un peligroso asesino, apodado Barba Azul, tiene aterrorizados a los habitantes de París. A todos menos a Lucille, una modesta costurera que, desoyendo el clamor popular, decide salir a dar un paseo nocturno por la ciudad.

programme.title: Fear X
programme.desc: Harry (John Turturro), un agente de seguridad de un centro comercial, se dedica a investigar obsesivamente el asesinato de su mujer.

programme.title: La Casa Roja
programme.desc: Un anciano y su hermana ocultan un terrible secreto a su hija adolescente adoptiva, sobre una granja abandonada escondida, ubicada en lo profundo del bosque.

programme.title: La fugitiva
programme.desc: Frank Johnson se convierte en testigo ocular de un asesinato. Su esposa, la policía y el asesino lo persiguen por San Francisco.

programme.title: El malvado Zaroff
programme.desc: El conde Zaroff es un loco millonario que vive en una isla solitaria y se dedica a cazar a los náufragos como si fueran animales.

programme.title: Ojos que te acechan
programme.desc: "El Ojo" es un agente especial del Servicio Británico, cuya misión es seguir a Joanna Eris, una mujer sospechosa de chantajear a un miembro del gobierno

programme.title: Cut off
programme.desc: El policía forense Paul Herzfeld encuentra dentro de la cabeza de un cuerpo mutilado una cápsula que contiene un número de teléfono y el nombre de su hija.

programme.title: Un cubo de sangre
programme.desc: Un ayudante de camarero tonto es aclamado como artista por un gato muerto cubierto de yeso que se confunde con una hábil estatuilla. El deseo de más elogios pronto conduce a una serie de obras cada vez más mortales.

programme.title: Ausentes
programme.desc: Julia y Samuel se mudan con los niños a una urbanización en las afueras de la ciudad. Parece un lugar ideal, pero Julia pronto descubrirá que tan idílico paraje esconde algo extraño. Se da cuenta de que la urbanización está completamente desierta.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: Mala sangre
programme.desc: Dresden se ve envuelto en una lucha territorial entre bandas de vampiros cuando le presionan para volver a saldar una deuda.

programme.title: The Dresden Files: Beneficiario esencial
programme.desc: Cuando un hombre muere en la oficina de Harry, este se ve obligado a investigar una compleja trama de asesinato ligada al pasado de Bob.

programme.title: Vagrant Queen: Sunshine Exprésate
programme.desc: Elida deja el equipo para tomar un trabajo de carroñero mientras Isaac y Amae luchan contra los secuestradores en un tren.

programme.title: Vagrant Queen: Sin pistas
programme.desc: A la deriva en el espacio, el equipo se encuentra en medio de un misterioso asesinato muy extraño.

programme.title: Andrómeda
programme.desc: La tripulación busca a un líder de la Mancomunidad perdido hace mucho tiempo que se ha escondido.

programme.title: Andrómeda

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Alex Dee
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary big band leader and pianist Count Basie brought his famous big band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague to perform two sets. Basie, whose minimalist pianism and blues-oriented swing style had cemented his popularity as early as the 1930s, was in the midst of a European tour and had recorded his live album 'On the Road' the previous night in Montreux, Switzerland. Here is the second of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: Melody Gardot, Charles Staab, Sam Minaie & Mitchell Long
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time. From David Bowie and Iggy Pop to Pink Floyd and Chet Baker, countless stars recorded unforgettable music here until the studio closed in the 1980s. Three decades later, Château d'Hérouville has reopened its doors. This program follows American singer-songwriter Melody Gardot as she visits the legendary studio. After an accident in 2003 left her hypersensitive to light and sound, Gardot discovered the healing power of music. At Hérouville, she gives an interview and plays a breathtaking live set. Her performance opens with a beautiful version of ‘Baby I'm a Fool' and includes ‘If The Stars Were Mine' and ‘Les Étoiles,' before concluding with the Chet Baker hit ‘You Don't Know What Love Is.' Melody Gardot (piano, guitar, vocals) is accompanied by Charles Staab (drums), Sam Minaie (double bass), Mitchell Long (guitar), Sylvain Gontard (trumpet), Ludovic Beier (accordion), Artyom Manoukyan (cello), and Guillaume Latour, Alexandra Kondo, and Benjamin Ducasse (violin).

programme.title: Miriam Makeba, J.K. Naimro, Stanley Todd & Al Sanders
programme.sub-title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist. Her career flourished in the US, where she released several albums. Makeba was among the first African musicians to receive worldwide recognition. She brought African music to a Western audience, and popularized the world music and Afropop genres. Her performances at Estival Lugano is beyond incredible. Her voice, the power and the soul summarizes her musicality in 40 minutes, together with her band and extremely talented backing-vocals.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Miles Davis, John Scofield, Darryl Jones & Robert Irving III
programme.sub-title: Miles Davis Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1985, legendary American trumpeter Miles Davis gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Davis' influence on the course of jazz cannot be overstated, as he helped shape bebop, modal jazz, hard bop, and electric jazz, and nurtured the talent of influential musicians, including that of seminal saxophonist John Coltrane.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg. In contrast to melodic variations on a theme, the Goldberg Variations do not follow the melody, but rather use the aria's bass line and chord progression. Every third variation in the series of 30 is a canon that follows an ascending pattern. The Goldberg Variations are among Bach's most celebrated works, which gained an even larger audience thanks to Glenn Gould's legendary recordings of the work in 1955 and 1981.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Gewandhausorchester Leipzig
programme.sub-title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig's Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek's Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek's only symphony – was never performed during the composer's lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today. Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504. This work, which premiered while Mozart was visiting Prague in 1787, is often referred to as the ‘Prague Symphony'.

programme.title: Gewandhausorchester Leipzig, Andris Nelsons & Kristine Opolais
programme.desc: Andris Nelsons, together with his then-wife, the great soprano Kristine Opolais and the Gewandhausorchester Leipzig present a program dedicated to Antonin Dvořák, singing the melodies that the composer hid in all layers of his music with tender, warm, soft colors. Nelsons' tempos remain calm and relaxed, allowing the omnipresent beauty of Dvořák's music to unfold and flood the Gewandhaus. The program opens with Othello, a Concert Overture for Orchestra, Op. 93. Opolais performs “Song to the Moon” from Rusalka, “Songs my Mother Taught Me” from Gypsy Songs, Op. 55/4. This is followed by the Polonaise and 'O, marno, marno to je' from Rusalka and 'Dobrá! Já mu je dám!... Jak je mi?' from Smetana's opera Dalibor. The concert closes with a performance of Dvořák's Symphony no. 9 in E Minor, Op. 95 (“From the New World”). Recorded at the Gewandhaus, Leipzig in May 2017.

programme.desc: A man finds out he's fathered 533 children through anonymous donations to a fertility clinic 2 years ago.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: A small shop owner is furious at a large candy company moving in, but a romance blossoms with her competitor.

programme.title: The Spy Who Dumped Me
programme.desc: Two friends become entangled in a conspiracy when one of them discovers the boyfriend who dumped her was a spy

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: Prevenge
programme.desc: A pitch black, wryly British comedy from the mind of Alice Lowe, Prevenge follows Ruth, a pregnant woman on a killing spree. It's her misanthropic unborn baby dictating Ruth's actions, holding society responsible for the absence of a father. Struggling with her strain of prepartum madness, Ruth must ultimately choose between redemption and destruction at the moment of motherhood.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave
programme.desc: In 1978, one film changed the face of cinema forever. Long established as one of the most debated and divisive movies of all time, I Spit On Your Grave has been condemned by some as 'vile and depraved', whilst others hail it as a 'misunderstood masterpiece of cinema', 'the ultimate feminist movie'. Re-experience the phenomenon that shocked and divided the world, and influenced an entire genre and generation of film-makers, with Camille Keaton's portrayal of young writer Jennifer Hills, her horrific plans for revenge, and some of the most gruesomely, unforgettable scenes ever captured to film.

programme.title: Gladiatress
programme.desc: 55BC Somewhere In Britain: The Princesses of the Dubonni tribe are three unlikely sisters: Smirgut The Fierce (Fiona Allen), ferocious warrior and full-time mum, Dwyfuc (Doon Mackichan), desperate spinster in search of a hairy husband and Worthaboutapig (Sally Phillips), clumsy village bee-herder. Roman soldiers kidnap Dwyfuc, detaining her in Boulogne. Seduced by Roman society, she reveals locations of British ports crucial to the Romanss invasion strategy. Smirgut and Worthaboutapig set out on a perilous rescue mission together they must prevent the downfall of Celtic Britain, encountering gods, lawyers, soothsayers, barbarians and the Otherworld. Girl power is alive and kicking and ready to take on the Romans

programme.title: Valhalla: Legend of Thor
programme.desc: No man, woman or child may defy the gods. When Thor and Loki seek refuge in the home of mortals, the youngest son fails to heed a warning from the gods. As atonement for the family's sins, the gods take the two youngest children under their wing and embark on an epic adventure from Midgard to Valhalla that will see them stare down ruthless giants, barbaric gods and the dreaded wolf Fenrir.

programme.title: Pick of the Litter
programme.desc: Meet Patriot, Potomac, Primrose, Poppet and Phil, bred to bring independence, companionship and joy to the visually impaired. This is a dog-umentary with serious pedigree, being described as the most joyous film of the year by critics. Sure to melt your hearts we follow these pups through an intense two-year odyssey as they train to become dogs with serious responsibility. Totally pawesome!

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: A charming and endearing romantic comedy starring Evan Rachel Wood and Scott Speedman. The "black sheep" son of a wealthy family meets a free-spirited, but sheltered woman. To convince his family that he's finally straightened out his life, he takes her home for his brother's wedding where an improbable romance blooms, as she impresses everyone with her genuine, simple charms.

programme.title: Enemy Lines
programme.desc: Courage has no borders in this action-packed WWII thriller. November 1943. A British commando squad and American officer (Ed Westwick: Gossip Girl) are on a covert mission, deep behind enemy lines in Poland. Intent on extracting a sought-after Polish scientist, Dr Fabian (Pawel Delag: Schindlers List) from the Germans, the team have to contend with a German hunter unit and a Russian squad.

programme.title: Fall of the Krays
programme.desc: From the producers of Rise of the Footsoldier, the brutal brothers from Bethnal Green are back and bloodier than ever. Having secured their empire and their infamy, they must now defend both, as the obsession of a police officer becomes entwined with a burgeoning romance and a dangerous state of mind for Reggie and Ronnie respectively. The electric follow up to the ferocious Rise of the Krays.

programme.title: The Forger
programme.desc: A teenager wanders into Carmel, California, where he is soon introduced to the art-forgery community.

programme.title: Waiting for Anya
programme.desc: From the mind of world-renowned author Michael Morpurgo comes the cinematic adaptation of Waiting for Anya - a powerful and authentic true story of a young shepherd that had a key part to play in one of the world's most shocking moments in history.

programme.title: Louder Than Words
programme.desc: After the unexpected death of their daughter, a couple work to build a state of the art children's hospital where families are welcomed into the healing process.

programme.title: Where hands touch
programme.desc: In 1944, a 15-year-old girl, daughter of a white German mother and a black African father, meets a member of the Hitler Youth. They become bound by the realization of the horrors being committed around them.

programme.title: Sweet Home Carolina
programme.desc: (2017) Romantic comedy starring Heather McComb. A stressed-out single mum moves to South Carolina to claim an inherited house, where unexpected love and Southern charm await.

programme.title: The Wish Swap
programme.desc: (2025) Charming romcom with Emily Tennant and Jake Foy. When two strangers get each other's birthday wishes, can they team up to make both their dreams come true?

programme.title: Luckless In Love
programme.desc: Blogger Winnie and sports agent Holden are both dating with the intention to further their career. As their feelings grow, they discover the only people they are lying to are themselves. (2022)

programme.title: My One and Only
programme.desc: (2019) Romance starring Pascale Hutton. A woman enters a TV reality show designed to help her find 'The One'. But when a love triangle forms on the set, how will she choose the right path for herself?

programme.title: Love Takes Flight
programme.desc: Single mum Lizzy has built boundaries at work and personal life to protect herself. After meeting an impulsive pilot, Charlie, at work, will she be open to change and open herself up to love? (2019)

programme.title: The Sun is Also a Star
programme.desc: “What if I told you I could get you to fall in love with me…?” College-bound romantic Daniel Bae (Melton) and Jamaica-born pragmatist Natasha Kingsley (Shahidi) meet—and fall for each other—over one magical day amidst the fervor and flurry of New York City...

programme.title: A Rainy Day in New York
programme.desc: Woody Allen's romantic comedy A RAINY DAY IN NEW YORK tells the story of college sweethearts, Gatsby (Timothée Chalamet) and Ashleigh (Elle Fanning), whose plans for a romantic weekend together in New York City are dashed as quickly as the sunlight turns into showers.

programme.title: First Daughter
programme.desc: Samantha Mackenzie wants what every college freshman desires: to experience life away from home and parents. It's not going to be easy, however, because home for Sam is the White House, and her dad is the President of the United States.

programme.title: Guess Who
programme.desc: A sarcastic father (Bernie Mac) has plenty to say about his daughter wanting to marry a white boy (Ashton Kutcher).

programme.title: Benny & Joon
programme.desc: Johnny Depp and Mary Stuart Masterson star in this quirky romantic Drama about two misfits who Comedye together as a result of an unusual poker game. Aidan Quinn and Julianne Moore co-star.

programme.title: Lovemakers
programme.desc: When a failing dating agency is bought by a mysterious businessman, three of its staff are given one assignment: make a young Hollywood movie star fall in love with the businessman's sister.

programme.title: Back To Love
programme.desc: A young widow returns home for the first time in three years to help prepare her sister's wedding. She is forced to confront her past, including the man she never expected to fall for.

programme.title: Before You Say I Do
programme.desc: George wants to marry Jane, but she swore off marriage after her first husband broke her heart. After wishing he had met Jane before she got married, George winds up ten years in the past.

programme.title: Enchanted Christmas
programme.desc: When she left Utah as a young widow, Laura Trudeau left behind her father, her love of dance -- and an old heartbreak. Now, she must return home to spearhead the renovation of a derelict hotel, which must be restored in time for a Christmas Eve benefit dance performance. But Laura is shocked to learn that her old love, Ricardo Archuleta, the boy who jilted her for a professional dance career, is the star of the dance benefit. And when his dance partner Taylor walks out on the show for an out-of-town audition, Laura has to step in for her, reawakening her love of the dance, not to mention her old feelings for Ricardo -- a potent combination that has her head spinning.

programme.title: Christmas with a Prince
programme.desc: Pediatric specialist Tasha Miller is caring for two young patients plus one sinfully gorgeous royal. She knew Prince Alexander at boarding school long ago and thinks he's still a self-absorbed, incorrigible heartbreaker. But when Tasha sees him with the children, his kindness and caring nature shine through so brightly that Dr. Tasha can't help but be attracted.

programme.title: Christmas With A Prince: Becoming Royal
programme.desc: Its Christmas again and Dr Tasha is on her way to meet Prince Alexander in St. Savarre. Though this is a happy time it is also a very stressful as a treaty is being negotiated between St. Savarre and Vandelien. When Tasha arrives, Alex surprises her by asking for her hand in marriage. She accepts and they immediately begin planning the wedding. When Princess Miranda finds out she is not happy and concocts a plan to put a halt to this fairy-tale.

programme.title: Christmas with A Prince: The Royal Baby
programme.desc: Things get complicated for the expecting Prince Alexander and Dr. Tasha when a Royal State Visit is planned abroad, passing through her hometown. The couple must struggle with defying tradition and delivering, literally, on expectations.

programme.title: Christmas Catch
programme.desc: Detective Bennett is on the trail of a thief and goes undercover to find where he's hiding the loot. While undercover, she falls for the supposed thief and begins to suspect that he's been framed. Was he framed? Or are feelings clouding her judgment?

programme.title: People Presents: Once Upon a Main Street
programme.desc: Amelia buys an available storefront, planning to open a year-round Christmas shop.

programme.title: Ancient Recipes
programme.desc: Sohla's celebrating Oktoberfest by recreating the original pretzel recipe.

programme.title: Last Chance for Christmas
programme.desc: Santa's handsome but beleaguered stable master John must rush off to Alaska.

programme.title: My Christmas Grandpa
programme.desc: Girl requests cashier as grandpa for Christmas Vivica A. Fox, Bill Cobbs star.

programme.title: Four Christmases and a Wedding
programme.desc: Chloe (Arielle Kebbel) is hired to plan the local Christmas Festival.

programme.title: People Presents: Once Upon a Main Street
programme.desc: Amelia buys an available storefront, planning to open a year-round Christmas shop.

programme.title: Amber Alert
programme.desc: A woman goes on the run with her children to escape an abusive husband, who is the District Attorney. He puts out an Amber Alert for them.

programme.title: Sugar Baby Murder
programme.desc: A new executive assistant to a business tycoon learns that a life of luxury can come at a deadly price.

programme.title: Cheer for Your Life
programme.desc: A high schooler faces a brutal cheer initiation. When things turn deadly and she disappears, her mom must act.

programme.title: The Bad Son
programme.desc: An elusive serial killer is killing innocent women in Seattle. The police and FBI are on the killer's trail but were never prepared to face a bizarre twist in the case.

programme.title: Our Dream Wedding
programme.desc: Haley, staunchly anti-marriage, tries on her grandma's magical veil and sees her future with boyfriend Scott.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: An unlikely group of former '80s video game champions step up to save the world from an alien invasion in this visually spectacular action-adventure.

programme.title: Grown Ups 2
programme.desc: The all-star comedy cast from "Grown Ups" returns with some exciting new additions!

programme.title: Stripes (1981)
programme.desc: Bill Murray and Harold Ramis as bootcamp flatfoots who join the Army to meet girls and actually succeed. Mud wrestling will never be the same.

programme.title: Man Of The House (2005)
programme.desc: A hard-edged Texas Ranger is forced to go undercover as an assistant cheerleading coach to protect a group of college cheerleaders after they witness a murder.

programme.title: King of California
programme.desc: An unstable dad who after getting out of a mental institution tries to convince his daughter that there's Spanish gold buried somewhere under suburbia.

programme.title: Maja Ma
programme.desc: Pallavi Patel is the quintessential, middle aged, devoted housewife who is equally famous for her dance as she is for her cooking. But what happens when a rumor about her threatens to disrupt her middle-class family's ethos on the eve of her son Tejas' engagement to a rich, non-resident Indian girl?

programme.title: Lars and the real girl
programme.desc: Extremely shy Lars strikes up an unconventional relationship with a doll he finds on the Internet. On the advice of a doctor, his family and neighbours go along with his delusion.

programme.title: Dog Days
programme.desc: “What is it about dogs that brings us so much joy?” Lives are about to change forever, when human and canine paths intertwine in sunny Los Angeles. There's Elizabeth, a news anchor in her 30's, who not only having to deal with a bad breakup, is struggling to cheer up her depressed dog Sam.

programme.title: And Now... Make Your Peace with God
programme.desc: Two men ride toward Denver City, each chasing a ghost from the past—one seeks his father's killer, the other a treacherous friend who stole his gold. Along the way, a silent, deadly gunslinger joins them, his motives unknown. In the shadows of vengeance, alliances shift and secrets unravel.

programme.title: Cjamango
programme.desc: Just when Cjamango has won a bag of gold in a poker game, he is attacked by the gangs of El Tigre and Don Pablo.

programme.title: Massacre
programme.desc: A gang of gunrunners is pursued by Mexican Rurales and Yaqui Indians. The police want to stop the tribes from attacking farmers, while the Yaqui seek revenge for bad medicine that blinded their children. Both groups capture the criminals but find themselves trapped by angry tribes at a ruined mission. Can cops and criminals unite to survive?

programme.title: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
programme.desc: Fiery blonde half-breed Yellow Hair and her easygoing sidekick the Pecos Kid are after a fortune in Mayan gold.

programme.title: Minnesota Clay
programme.desc: In 1883, Clay, a gunfighter with health problems, is wrongfully imprisoned in Drunner Labor Camp. He was framed by Fox, the corrupt sheriff of Mesa Encantada. Fox now extorts the town's people, running a violent protection racket. Clay, determined to clear his name, is approached by bandit Ortiz, who wants him to kill Fox.

programme.title: Find the Lady
programme.desc: A model investigates the disappearance of her grandmother and is drawn into a web of kidnapping and murder.

programme.title: All Over the Town
programme.desc: Former RAF man Nat returns home only to find his newspaper job taken by a woman named Sally.

programme.title: The Secret Place
programme.desc: For Molly, life in London's East End is colourless.

programme.title: The Secret Place
programme.desc: For Molly, life in London's East End is colourless. The same is true for Freddie, her best friend who idolises her. But she is in love with the local crook, Gerry.

programme.title: Constant Husband
programme.desc: An Englishman wakes in a hotel bedroom suffering from amnesia and sets out to find his identity. He tracks down his wife but soon learns that the job she saw him leave for every morning did not exist. He learns to his disgust that that is the least of his lies. He is a cad and bigamist (or, worse, he has seven wives and identities). His female lawyer tries to keep him out of jail, though he prefers incarceration to multiple matrimony.

programme.title: The Reel Thing
programme.desc: Working as consultants for an archeology adventure film, Sydney and Nigel realize the Pharaoh Amun II's props are genuine, long-thought lost relics. How can they be?

programme.title: Out of the Past
programme.desc: Claudia discovers that she was Cleopatra's servant in a past life when she experiences déjà vu while watching a catalog from an Ancient Egyptian relics exposition.

programme.title: Eyes of Toklamanee
programme.desc: Sydney and her student Adam are onto his ancestors' fabled Eyes of Toklamanee, but they are pursued by mysterious gunmen.

programme.title: Run Sydney Run
programme.desc: Sydney and Nigel are ambushed in Russia. Two weeks later, Sydney wakes up in the house of a man called Tsarlov, who claims to have saved her.

programme.title: M.I.A.
programme.desc: Sydney gets kidnapped, but by whom? Nigel, Claudia and Cate will have to go through the list of enemies Sydney has made in the past and deduce which of them is responsible. Cue flashbacks.

programme.title: Dont Go Into the Woods
programme.desc: Sydney's friend phones to inform her that he's discovered information on the Golden Hawk of Maribor, lost since 1711. Sydney and Nigel travel to Lubjanka to meet him, but he's already gone.

programme.title: French Connection
programme.desc: While on a lecture tour with Nigel in Europe, Sydney is contacted by MI5 because she is the only one who can prevent an impending high-level assassination.

programme.title: Midnight Flight
programme.desc: Germania, ca. 400 AD: an artifact called Gunther's Scepter is sealed in a vault. Kleine Burgh, 2001: Sydney and Nigel are hired to find it using a crystal and a stone tablet.

programme.title: Killers
programme.desc: Spencer Aimes is just your average, undercover, super-assassin accustomed to a life of flashy sports cars and even flashier women. But when he meets Jen Kornfeldt, a fun-loving computer tech, he finds true love… and happily trades international intrigue for domestic bliss.

programme.title: Lost in the Pacific
programme.desc: A luxury airline is making its maiden flight, with a group of VIP passengers on board, when disaster strikes. A mechanical failure forces the plane to crash land and it ends up on a remote Pacific island where passengers and crew must wait to be rescued.

programme.title: A Perfect Plan
programme.desc: Four notorious thieves wake up in a fortified warehouse and are forced to commit an audacious diamond heist to win their freedom.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: A thriller centered on a young man who sets out to uncover the truth about his life after finding his baby photo on a missing persons website.

programme.title: Elysium
programme.desc: In 2154, two classes of people exist: the very wealthy, and the rest, who live on a ruined Earth.

programme.title: Anaconda 3: Offspring
programme.desc: A ruthless mercenary, Hammett (David Hasselhoff) and his team are on the hunt for a pair of giant snakes that have escaped and are on a mega-sized feeding frenzy.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Welcome To Raccoon City
programme.desc: Witness the beginning of Evil Raccoon City, which was once a booming home of pharmaceutical giant Umbrella Corporation, is now a dying Midwestern town. The company's exodus left the city a wasteland with great evil brewing below the surface. When that evil is unleashed, a group of survivors must work together to uncover the truth behind Umbrella and make it through the night.

programme.title: Gothika
programme.desc: A criminal psychologist (Berry) awakens to find herself a patient in the institution where she works, with no memory of the murder she's accused of committing. As she tries to regain her memory - and her freedom - a vengeful spirit manipulates her.

programme.title: Spotlight [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: Fever Pitch [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A sports fan's romantic courtship clashes with his obsession with his favorite football team. Based on the book by Nick Hornby.

programme.title: 13 Moons [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A man (Steve Buscemi) employed as a clown and his sidekick (Peter Dinklage) try to find a kidney donor for the son of a bail bondsman (David Proval).

programme.title: Love Again
programme.desc: Amidst a distant relationship with his father and losing his girlfriend to his best friend, Nathan's brokenness leads him on a journey of rediscovering hope and a healing heart to love again.

programme.title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth
programme.desc: An unexplained phenomenon has struck the Earth. Contact between most towns on Earth has been severed. A small area in Eastern Europe is the only location that still has electricity. When military forces venture outside, they discover a shocking truth - corpses everywhere. In stores, in cars, on roads, in hospitals and railway stations. Who or what is destroying all life on Earth? And how long can the last outpost of mankind endure?

programme.title: Agent Red [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Captain Matt Hendricks and Dr. Linda Christian are locked in a submarine with Russian terrorists that threaten to launch a chemical virus on US territory.

programme.title: Arlington Road [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Alex Dee
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Count Basie
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, legendary big band leader and pianist Count Basie brought his famous big band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague to perform two sets. Basie, whose minimalist pianism and blues-oriented swing style had cemented his popularity as early as the 1930s, was in the midst of a European tour and had recorded his live album 'On the Road' the previous night in Montreux, Switzerland. Here is the second of two sets recorded at the festival in 1979.

programme.title: Melody Gardot, Charles Staab, Sam Minaie & Mitchell Long
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time. From David Bowie and Iggy Pop to Pink Floyd and Chet Baker, countless stars recorded unforgettable music here until the studio closed in the 1980s. Three decades later, Château d'Hérouville has reopened its doors. This program follows American singer-songwriter Melody Gardot as she visits the legendary studio. After an accident in 2003 left her hypersensitive to light and sound, Gardot discovered the healing power of music. At Hérouville, she gives an interview and plays a breathtaking live set. Her performance opens with a beautiful version of ‘Baby I'm a Fool' and includes ‘If The Stars Were Mine' and ‘Les Étoiles,' before concluding with the Chet Baker hit ‘You Don't Know What Love Is.' Melody Gardot (piano, guitar, vocals) is accompanied by Charles Staab (drums), Sam Minaie (double bass), Mitchell Long (guitar), Sylvain Gontard (trumpet), Ludovic Beier (accordion), Artyom Manoukyan (cello), and Guillaume Latour, Alexandra Kondo, and Benjamin Ducasse (violin).

programme.title: Miriam Makeba, J.K. Naimro, Stanley Todd & Al Sanders
programme.sub-title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist. Her career flourished in the US, where she released several albums. Makeba was among the first African musicians to receive worldwide recognition. She brought African music to a Western audience, and popularized the world music and Afropop genres. Her performances at Estival Lugano is beyond incredible. Her voice, the power and the soul summarizes her musicality in 40 minutes, together with her band and extremely talented backing-vocals.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Miles Davis, John Scofield, Darryl Jones & Robert Irving III
programme.sub-title: Miles Davis Septet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1985, legendary American trumpeter Miles Davis gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Davis' influence on the course of jazz cannot be overstated, as he helped shape bebop, modal jazz, hard bop, and electric jazz, and nurtured the talent of influential musicians, including that of seminal saxophonist John Coltrane.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Zhu Xiao-Mei
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations. The work was first published in 1741 and was named after harpsichordist Johann Gottlieb Goldberg. In contrast to melodic variations on a theme, the Goldberg Variations do not follow the melody, but rather use the aria's bass line and chord progression. Every third variation in the series of 30 is a canon that follows an ascending pattern. The Goldberg Variations are among Bach's most celebrated works, which gained an even larger audience thanks to Glenn Gould's legendary recordings of the work in 1955 and 1981.

programme.title: Herbert Blomstedt & Gewandhausorchester Leipzig
programme.sub-title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig's Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek's Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek's only symphony – was never performed during the composer's lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today. Also on the program is Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Symphony No. 38 in D major, K. 504. This work, which premiered while Mozart was visiting Prague in 1787, is often referred to as the ‘Prague Symphony'.

programme.title: Gewandhausorchester Leipzig, Andris Nelsons & Kristine Opolais
programme.desc: Andris Nelsons, together with his then-wife, the great soprano Kristine Opolais and the Gewandhausorchester Leipzig present a program dedicated to Antonin Dvořák, singing the melodies that the composer hid in all layers of his music with tender, warm, soft colors. Nelsons' tempos remain calm and relaxed, allowing the omnipresent beauty of Dvořák's music to unfold and flood the Gewandhaus. The program opens with Othello, a Concert Overture for Orchestra, Op. 93. Opolais performs “Song to the Moon” from Rusalka, “Songs my Mother Taught Me” from Gypsy Songs, Op. 55/4. This is followed by the Polonaise and 'O, marno, marno to je' from Rusalka and 'Dobrá! Já mu je dám!... Jak je mi?' from Smetana's opera Dalibor. The concert closes with a performance of Dvořák's Symphony no. 9 in E Minor, Op. 95 (“From the New World”). Recorded at the Gewandhaus, Leipzig in May 2017.

The concert featured a few guest artists, including Laura Pausini, Chris Botti, and with an unexpected comedic banter with Bublé, Josh Groban.

programme.desc: La historia de amistad entre un profesor y Hachi, el perro de raza Akita que recoge perdido en una estación.
